_comment: Titles for the stakes in the beds, keyed by track id (the slug of the source filename). The catalog is GENERATED, so a title typed straight into garden-catalog.js is lost the next time that track is re-encoded - this file is where a name survives. Edit a name here and run `node tools/garden/encode.mjs --reshape` to write it through. Keep them to ~14 characters: the stake label truncates past that. Anything without an entry falls back to its filename, cleaned up.
